Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ayaan - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anjali - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Savitri - 62 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Pihu - 10 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Zoya - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The classroom - a blackboard, benches
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The classroom - Day

[Ayaan stands in the classroom. Anjali and Savitri stand near him.]

Savitri: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ayaan raises his hand to answer.]

Ayaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Ayaan writes on the blackboard.]

Ayaan (happily): "Hey, look at that!"

[Ayaan reads his book at his desk.]

Ayaan: "That's easy."

[Ayaan yawns in the class.]

Savitri (excited): "Okay, Ayaan."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan mops the floor.]

Ayaan: "Exactly right."

[Ayaan irons his school shirt.]

Ayaan: "I really enjoyed today."
